body: Extreme macro of a living meadow at golden-blue hour, camera at ground level looking slightly upward. Foreground: thousands of individual blades of grass razor-sharp, each catching thin emerald and gold rim-light. Scattered small six-petal wildflowers echoing the Seed of Life, centers glowing faint cyan. Dew droplets as tiny lenses. Background falls to deep black-green with gold firefly bokeh. One faint circular sacred-geometry sigil etched in the haze behind. Photoreal macro, f/1.4, volumetric rays.
